title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Runyang You、Yongqi Li、Meng Liu、Wenjie Wang、Liqiang Nie、Wenjie Li（机构：香港理工大学、山东建筑大学、中国科学技术大学、哈尔滨工业大学深圳）
paper_type_zh: 潜式推理测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 希望把 pass@k 式推理扩展迁移到连续推理模型、而这些模型没有词元概率或文本过程奖励输入的读者。
one_line: This work brings parallel sampling and reward-guided selection to latent reasoning by using dropout or noise for exploration and a step-level latent reward model for aggregation.
该工作用 dropout 或噪声在潜空间探索，并用逐步潜空间奖励模型聚合，把并行采样与奖励引导选择带入潜式推理。
why: It shows that inference scaling is not tied to textual chain-of-thought and supplies the sampling and scoring primitives needed to allocate compute in latent space.
inclusion_reason: It directly adapts parallel test-time sampling and trajectory aggregation to continuous latent reasoning, making the number of sampled latent paths an explicit inference-compute budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Parallel test-time scaling normally samples alternative token chains from a vocabulary distribution and then votes, ranks, or searches over them. Latent reasoning models replace intermediate tokens with continuous hidden vectors, making reasoning more compact but removing both ingredients that make this routine work: there is no categorical distribution from which to sample alternative thoughts, and there are no readable token likelihoods or text traces for a conventional process reward model to score.

The paper asks whether a continuous reasoning model can convert additional inference compute into the same kind of parallel exploration benefit. The problem requires more than adding arbitrary noise, because perturbations can destroy a latent trajectory instead of revealing a useful alternative. It also requires an aggregation signal that distinguishes promising hidden-state paths without pretending that an existing textual verifier understands a sequence of abstract vectors.

并行测试时扩展通常从词表分布中采样替代词元链，再对它们投票、排序或搜索。潜式推理模型用连续隐藏向量替代中间词元，使推理更紧凑，却移除了这一流程依赖的两项条件：没有可从中采样替代思维的类别分布，也没有可供传统过程奖励模型评分的可读词元概率或文本轨迹。

论文研究连续推理模型能否把额外推理计算转化为同类并行探索收益。问题不只是加入任意噪声，因为扰动可能摧毁潜轨迹，而不是揭示有用替代方案；它还需要一种聚合信号，能区分有希望的隐藏状态路径，却不假装既有文本验证器理解抽象向量序列。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method supplies separate primitives for exploration and selection. Monte Carlo dropout keeps dropout active during inference and samples alternative effective weight configurations, representing epistemic uncertainty. Additive Gaussian Noise perturbs each latent thought with a controlled isotropic vector, representing input or trajectory uncertainty. Both mechanisms create parallel hidden-state paths without turning those paths back into long textual chains.

For selection, LatentRM extends the latent backbone with a scalar head that scores the promise of each intermediate thought. It is trained comparatively at every reasoning step, using the empirical correctness of stochastic completions as a quality signal. Cumulative step logits rank whole trajectories, enabling best-of-N and beam search. The framework therefore treats latent-space sample count as an adjustable compute budget, while retaining a model-native scorer for what cannot be inspected in language.

方法分别提供探索和选择的基础组件。蒙特卡洛 dropout 在推理时保持 dropout 激活，并采样不同的有效权重配置，表示认知不确定性。加性高斯噪声以受控各向同性向量扰动每个潜思维，表示输入或轨迹不确定性。两种机制都能产生并行隐藏状态路径，而无需把这些路径重新变成长文本思维链。

选择方面，LatentRM 为潜式主干扩展标量头，对每个中间思维的前景评分。它在每个推理步骤进行比较式训练，以随机完成结果的经验正确率作为质量信号。累积的步骤 logits 对完整轨迹排序，从而支持 best-of-N 和束搜索。该框架因此把潜空间样本数视为可调计算预算，同时保留对语言无法检查内容的模型原生评分器。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors evaluate COCONUT, CODI, CoLaR, Latent-SFT, and Render-of-Thought backbones. At every latent step, MC dropout applies a randomly sampled dropout mask after feed-forward layers; Gaussian sampling adds a zero-mean perturbation with tunable scale. They vary the number of parallel trajectories from one to sixty-four and evaluate solution coverage, the latent equivalent of pass@k. Hyperparameters are tuned by coverage@64, with reported architecture-specific practical ranges for dropout and noise.

To train LatentRM, the authors sample latent trajectories and run multiple stochastic completions from every intermediate thought. The fraction ending in the correct answer becomes a thought-quality label. Rather than independent binary classification, the scorer uses a step-wise contrastive loss across candidates at the same position. At inference, cumulative scores guide best-of-N or beam search; beam width is square root of N so its decoding cost is matched to N independent samples. Experiments use GSM8K Test, GSM8K-Hard, MultiArith, and transfer tests on MATH500.

作者评测 COCONUT、CODI、CoLaR、Latent-SFT 和 Render-of-Thought 主干。在每个潜步骤，蒙特卡洛 dropout 在前馈层后施加随机采样的 dropout 掩码；高斯采样加入均值为零、尺度可调的扰动。他们把并行轨迹数从一变到六十四，并评测解题覆盖率，即潜式版本的 pass@k。超参数通过 coverage@64 调整，并报告面向不同架构的实用 dropout 和噪声范围。

训练 LatentRM 时，作者采样潜轨迹，并从每个中间思维运行多次随机完成。最终得到正确答案的比例成为思维质量标签。评分器不做独立二分类，而是在同一位置的候选间使用逐步对比损失。推理时，累积分数引导 best-of-N 或束搜索；束宽设为 N 的平方根，使解码成本与 N 条独立样本匹配。实验使用 GSM8K Test、GSM8K-Hard、MultiArith，并在 MATH500 上测试迁移。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Both stochastic mechanisms produce increasing coverage as more paths are sampled, with diminishing marginal gains at larger N. MC dropout is reported as the more consistently effective sampler across the shown COCONUT, CODI, and CoLaR curves. At N equal to 64, COCONUT and CODI can reach nearly equal coverage even though CODI is stronger at N equal to one, demonstrating that a parallel budget can narrow base-model gaps rather than merely preserve their ordering.

The framework also transfers beyond the small initial backbones. On MATH500, Render-of-Thought with a 4B Qwen3-VL backbone improves from 20.3% to 22.0% at N equal to 16. LatentRM produces gains for both best-of-N and beam search under matched budgets, while the analysis shows distinct exploration geometries: dropout tends toward structured directed expansion, whereas Gaussian noise broadens local diversity around the deterministic trajectory. The evidence supports scalable latent exploration, not a claim that any noise level is safe.

两种随机机制都在采样更多路径时提高覆盖率，但在较大 N 下边际收益递减。报告显示，在 COCONUT、CODI 和 CoLaR 曲线上，蒙特卡洛 dropout 是更稳定有效的采样器。当 N 为六十四时，COCONUT 和 CODI 可达到近似覆盖率，尽管 CODI 在 N 为一时更强，这表明并行预算能缩小基础模型差距，而不只是保持原有排序。

框架也能迁移到初始小主干以外。在 MATH500 上，具有 4B Qwen3-VL 主干的 Render-of-Thought 在 N 为十六时从 20.3% 提升到 22.0%。LatentRM 在匹配预算下为 best-of-N 和束搜索都带来收益；分析还显示不同探索几何：dropout 倾向于结构化定向扩张，而高斯噪声围绕确定性轨迹扩大局部多样性。证据支持可扩展的潜式探索，而非宣称任何噪声尺度都安全。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new contribution is to make the two operations behind parallel scaling native to continuous reasoning. Earlier latent models can be efficient because they avoid verbalizing thoughts, but that efficiency normally comes with deterministic or weakly stochastic inference. MC dropout and Gaussian perturbation provide principled sources of alternative latent paths, while LatentRM supplies a scorer where token probabilities and textual process rewards are unavailable.

The contrastive training formulation is important because it evaluates thoughts relative to alternatives at the same reasoning depth. The paper does not claim that latent vectors become interpretable or that a latent reward is a proof checker. Instead, it establishes an operational contract: stochastic latent paths provide coverage, rollout-derived labels train a selector, and a matched aggregation budget tests whether more hidden-space computation improves final answers.

新的贡献是让并行扩展背后的两种操作原生适用于连续推理。早期潜模型因避免把思维语言化而高效，但这种效率通常伴随确定性或弱随机推理。蒙特卡洛 dropout 和高斯扰动提供了有原则的替代潜路径来源，LatentRM 则在没有词元概率和文本过程奖励时提供评分器。

对比训练表述很重要，因为它在相同推理深度上相对替代方案评估思维。论文并未声称潜向量变得可解释，也未把潜奖励称为证明检查器；它建立的是可操作契约：随机潜路径提供覆盖率，rollout 导出的标签训练选择器，匹配的聚合预算检验更多隐藏空间计算是否改善最终答案。

title: Limitations
局限
html: LatentRM training requires many stochastic completions to label intermediate thoughts, which can be costly and can inherit errors from the final-answer metric. Noise and dropout settings are backbone dependent; excessive perturbation can make trajectories incoherent, while too little produces redundant samples. The main evidence is arithmetic reasoning with relatively small latent backbones, and hidden-vector scores are difficult to audit for factual, safety, or tool-use failures. A gain in coverage also does not by itself establish a favorable wall-clock trade-off.
LatentRM 训练需要许多随机完成来标注中间思维，这可能昂贵，并会继承最终答案指标的错误。噪声和 dropout 设置依赖主干；扰动过多会使轨迹失去连贯性，过少则产生冗余样本。主要证据来自相对较小潜式主干的算术推理，隐藏向量分数也难以审计事实、安全或工具使用失败。覆盖率收益本身也不能证明存在有利的墙钟权衡。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a latent-reasoning model is compact but its deterministic trajectory leaves accuracy on the table. Begin with a small parallel budget and calibrate dropout or noise on held-out coverage, then compare LatentRM best-of-N with a matched-cost beam search and a nonparametric vote. Keep explicit answers and execution traces for downstream auditing: the latent selector can be efficient, but it should not be the only safeguard where a final answer must be externally checked.
当潜式推理模型很紧凑、但确定性轨迹仍损失准确率时可使用此工作。应从较小并行预算开始，在保留集覆盖率上校准 dropout 或噪声，再将 LatentRM best-of-N 与成本匹配的束搜索和非参数投票比较。为下游审计保留显式答案和执行轨迹：潜选择器可能高效，但当最终答案必须外部检查时，它不应是唯一保障。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read coverage curves before aggregation results. Coverage answers whether sampling can uncover a correct latent path; LatentRM results answer whether the system can identify one after it exists. The paper's strongest conceptual value is this separation, because it prevents a poor selector from being blamed on a sampler or a low-diversity sampler from being hidden by a strong scorer. The GitHub release is the practical starting point for checking latent-backbone compatibility and the exact noise schedules.
应先阅读覆盖率曲线，再看聚合结果。覆盖率回答采样能否发现正确潜路径；LatentRM 结果回答路径存在后系统能否识别它。论文最强的概念价值就在这种分离，因为它避免把差选择器归咎于采样器，也避免让强评分器掩盖低多样性采样器。GitHub 发布是检查潜式主干兼容性和精确噪声日程的实际起点。
